# CraftSound Audio Workstation & Editor (mix.arshadakl.in)

> CraftSound is a modern, free, browser-based multitrack audio editor, trimmer, and merger. It runs entirely client-side using Web Audio API and IndexedDB without uploading audio files to external servers.

- **Website**: https://mix.arshadakl.in/
- **Creator / Developer**: Arshad (https://arshadakl.in)
- **License**: MIT License (Open Source)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/arshadakl/audio-editor

## Core Capabilities
- **Audio Trimmer**: Cut, crop, and trim MP3, WAV, OGG, FLAC, M4A, and AAC files directly in browser with millisecond accuracy.
- **Audio Merger & Multitrack Mixer**: Layer multiple audio tracks simultaneously with individual volume, stereo panning, mute, and solo controls.
- **Audio Splitter**: Split audio clips cleanly at the playhead position without quality degradation.
- **Waveform Visualizer**: High-resolution interactive canvas waveform display with peak analysis.
- **Offline & Private**: Audio files never leave your device. All decoding, processing, and rendering happen inside the client browser.
- **Export Formats**: Studio-grade uncompressed WAV (16-bit / 24-bit PCM at 44.1kHz or 48kHz) and MP3 (up to 320 kbps).
- **Zero Server Uploads**: Complete privacy guaranteed for podcasts, music production, voice recordings, and sensitive audio.

## Links & Guides

- [Audio Merger Guide](https://mix.arshadakl.in/#merge): How to combine and mix multiple tracks into one audio file.
- [Privacy Policy](https://mix.arshadakl.in/#privacy): Details on zero-data collection and local IndexedDB storage.
